subject: Coordinating initial discovery — multi-stakeholder window & procurement join
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@edgecore.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Coordinating initial discovery — multi-stakeholder window & procurement join

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the intro earlier. Per our conversation I'd like to lock a 30–45 minute discovery to bring together the champion (you), your engineering lead, our solutions engineer, and a brief procurement/security touchpoint so we can confirm scope and next steps.

Can you confirm whether procurement needs to be on the initial call or if a follow-up is OK? If procurement should join we can keep the first call to 45 minutes and focus on:
- high-level goals and success criteria (10m)
- technical surface & integration constraints (15m)
- compliance/hosting + next steps (15m)

Proposed windows (Pacific):
- Wed 2027-05-19 09:00–09:45 PT
- Thu 2027-05-20 13:00–13:45 PT

If neither works, share 2 times that work for you and Lena and I will loop in Soojin (SE) and Olga (security) as needed. I attached a short attendee prep checklist and a SOC2 highlights one-pager for procurement/security to preview.

Quick ask: please include Lena's calendar addresses or available windows so I can finalize.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

—Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Redwood-Prep-Attendee-Checklist.pdf (pdf, 1pg); SOC2-highlights.pdf (pdf, 2pg)

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@edgecore.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Morales <lena.morales@edgecore.com>, procurement@edgecore.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 17:40:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordinating initial discovery — multi-stakeholder window & procurement join

Aditya —

Thanks for the clear options. Quick answers:
- Yes, please have procurement join — they'll want the SOC2 summary ahead of time.
- Lena (engineering) prefers mornings but has an afternoon block on Thu if needed. Her suggested slots (PT):
  * Wed 2027-05-19 10:30–11:15 (conflicts for her)
  * Thu 2027-05-20 13:00–13:45 (this looks good)

If Thu 13:00 works for your SE and security rep, let's lock that. Agenda sounds good — can we tighten the technical segment to 12 minutes so we have time for a 8–10 minute procurement Q&A?

Also, could you share the SOC2 highlights and the one-page run-of-show for the call so procurement can review?

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel
Senior Product Manager, EdgeCore Systems
samir.patel@edgecore.com | +1 650-555-3344

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@edgecore.com>, Lena Morales <lena.morales@edgecore.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, procurement@edgecore.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:24:55 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordinating initial discovery — multi-stakeholder window & procurement join

Samir / Lena —

Thu 2027-05-20 13:00–13:45 PT works for our team. Confirming attendees:
- Samir Patel (champion)
- Lena Morales (eng lead)
- Aditya Rao (AE)
- Soojin Lee (Solutions Engineer) — will cover integration and demos
- Olga Petrov (Security & Compliance) — will cover SOC2/Qs and evidence flow
- Procurement (EdgeCore) — included on this thread

Attachments included: SOC2-highlights.pdf (2pg) and a 1-page meeting run of show (Redwood-Prep-Attendee-Checklist.pdf). I also added a calendar invite (calendar-invite-EDG-Discovery.ics) to this thread — please accept if the time is good.

Proposed compact agenda (35–45m):
- 0–5m: introductions & success criteria (Aditya)
- 5–17m: technical surface + integration Qs (Soojin + Lena)
- 17–28m: deployment options / hosting + security evidence (Olga)
- 28–36m: procurement & commercial next steps (Aditya + procurement)
- 36–45m: open Q&A and immediate next steps (all)

Notes / trade-offs: if procurement has many contract-level Qs we may need a separate session; the initial goal is to validate technical fit and outline commercial constraints.

Please reply-all to confirm and accept the invite. If procurement needs more detail beforehand I can drop a brief procurement cheat-sheet.

Thanks —Aditya

Attachments: SOC2-highlights.pdf; Redwood-Prep-Attendee-Checklist.pdf; calendar-invite-EDG-Discovery.ics

From: Lena Morales <lena.morales@edgecore.com>

On Wed, May 12, 2027 at 8:24 AM Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thu 2027-05-20 13:00–13:45 PT works for our team. Confirming attendees: ...

Thanks — that time works for me and I've accepted the invite. A couple quick asks from engineering/procurement before the call:
- Please keep the call non-recorded (we have internal policy during initial discovery)
- Add a 5–8 minute dedicated slot for network/security questions (Lena + Olga)
- Any notes on data residency or IP model would be helpful in the run-of-show — procurement will want to see where logs/keys live at a high level

We appreciate the SOC2 one-pager; procurement is reviewing it now. If you can send a very short note (bullet list) on data residency and key-management options ahead of the meeting, that would help speed decisions.

See you Thu.

—Lena Morales
Lead Software Engineer | EdgeCore Systems
lena.morales@edgecore.com | +1 415-555-7788
